title: Does Chemical Use Mitigate or Exacerbate Production Risk? Evidence From Conventional Maize Farms in Northern Italy
title_zh: 化学使用是缓解还是加剧生产风险？来自意大利北部常规玉米农场的证据
title_primary: 化学使用是缓解还是加剧生产风险？来自意大利北部常规玉米农场的证据
title_secondary: Does Chemical Use Mitigate or Exacerbate Production Risk? Evidence From Conventional Maize Farms in Northern Italy
authors: Thi Thanh Thuong Dang, Linda Arata, Paolo Sckokai
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the relationships between chemical use, namely fertilisers and pesticides, and the production risk of conventional maize in Northern Italy. Using data from the Italian Farm Accountancy Data Network for the period 2015–2020, merged with a station‐based weather dataset, we analyse the production risk through moments of farm‐level yield and revenue probability distributions, namely the mean, variance, negative semi‐variance, skewness and lower partial skewness. Our empirical results, which are robust to potential unobserved confounders, show that higher fertiliser application is correlated with a lower downside risk for per‐hectare revenue and higher spending on pesticides is associated with an increase in expected yield. Furthermore, our results also reveal a negative relationship between crop exposure to extreme heat and the variance of per‐hectare revenue. The findings suggest a potential trade‐off in reducing pesticide use to meet the European Union's agricultural sustainability goals, as lower application of pesticides may lower average production.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部常规玉米生产中化学品使用（即化肥和农药）与生产风险之间的关系。我们使用2015—2020年意大利农场会计数据网络的数据，并将其与基于气象站点的天气数据集合并，通过农场层面产量和收入概率分布的矩来分析生产风险，即均值、方差、负半方差、偏度和下偏度。我们的实证结果对潜在未观测混杂因素具有稳健性，表明较高的化肥施用量与每公顷收入的下行风险较低相关，而较高的农药支出与预期产量增加相关。此外，我们的结果还揭示了作物暴露于极端高温与每公顷收入方差之间存在负相关关系。研究结果表明，在实现欧盟农业可持续发展目标的过程中，减少农药使用可能存在潜在权衡，因为较低的农药施用量可能会降低平均产量。

title: Measuring Markets for Network Goods
title_zh: 网络商品市场的度量
title_primary: 网络商品市场的度量
title_secondary: Measuring Markets for Network Goods
authors: Leonardo Bursztyn, Matthew Gentzkow, Rafael Jiménez-Durán, Aaron Leonard, Filip Milojević, and Christopher Roth
official: 官方在线 2026-09-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Market definition is challenging in settings with network effects, where substitution patterns depend on changes in network size. We study these effects in the context of social media. We conduct an incentivized experiment comparing substitution in response to a proposed U.S. TikTok ban, in which all users simultaneously leave the app, with substitution when only a single user deactivates.
abstract_zh: 在市场具有网络效应的情境下，市场界定颇具挑战性，因为替代模式取决于网络规模的变化。我们以社交媒体为背景研究这些效应。我们开展了一项激励性实验，比较了在拟议的美国TikTok禁令下，所有用户同时离开应用时的替代行为，与仅单个用户停用时的替代行为。

title: Making Everyone’s Preferences Count: A Prospect Theory Approach to Valuing Health Improvements
title_zh: 让每个人的偏好都算数：前景理论视角下的健康改善价值评估
title_primary: 让每个人的偏好都算数：前景理论视角下的健康改善价值评估
title_secondary: Making Everyone’s Preferences Count: A Prospect Theory Approach to Valuing Health Improvements
authors: Karen Mulligan, Drishti Baid, Jason N. Doctor, Darius N. Lakdawalla
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Health technology assessment bodies and policymakers have grappled with the issue of whose preferences – the general healthy population or the patient population – should be incorporated into traditional cost-effectiveness analysis. This debate arises because healthy individuals and patients often value the same health state differently, and cost-effectiveness will undervalue health-related quality of life (HRQoL) for individuals with chronic illness or disability because it cannot account for adaptation. Prospect theory (PT) provides a framework that permits adaptation since it assumes individuals evaluate outcomes relative to a reference point. We estimate utility over HRQoL in a PT framework in a nationally representative U.S. population and compare directly with utility estimates in an EU framework from the same population. Consistent with previous studies in the monetary and health domains, we find evidence of probability weighting bias and loss aversion over health. Using the PT utility estimates, we demonstrate how PT can be incorporated into healthcare value assessment and present the resulting implications for medical decision making.
abstract_zh: 卫生技术评估机构与政策制定者一直面临一个难题：在传统成本-效果分析中，应纳入谁的偏好——一般健康人群还是患者人群？这一争论源于健康个体与患者往往对同一健康状态赋予不同价值，且成本-效果分析无法解释适应性，因而会低估慢性疾病或残疾患者的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。前景理论（PT）提供了一个允许适应性存在的框架，因为它假设个体相对于参考点来评估结果。我们在具有全国代表性的美国人群中，基于前景理论框架估计了HRQoL效用，并将其与同一人群在欧盟框架下的效用估计直接进行比较。与先前在货币和健康领域的研究一致，我们发现概率加权偏差和健康损失厌恶的证据。利用前景理论效用估计，我们展示了如何将前景理论纳入医疗价值评估，并呈现其对医疗决策的启示。

title: Remote work and effort provision in teams
title_zh: 远程工作与团队中的努力供给
title_primary: 远程工作与团队中的努力供给
title_secondary: Remote work and effort provision in teams
authors: E Glenn Dutcher, Krista J Saral
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Remote work policies remain controversial partly because of productivity concerns, which are potentially exacerbated in team settings. Using experiments, we isolate how location-based beliefs of teammate effort affect the own-effort choices of participants assigned to work with remote and office-based teammates. Participants perform a real effort task and can contribute this effort to an individual account, paying a piece rate wage, or to a team account using a minimum-effort payment scheme. We find that remote workers do not complete fewer tasks than their office-based counterparts. Yet, teams suffer from lower effort due to workers responding to beliefs that remote teammates contribute less effort to the team. In a follow-up treatment, we demonstrate that these location-based beliefs remain salient even under a revenue-sharing team payment scheme where beliefs of free-riding may have dominated. Finally, we provide unique evidence that the COVID-19 pandemic may have shifted beliefs to be more pessimistic about the effort of remote workers but did not alter the actual effort.
abstract_zh: 远程工作政策仍具争议，部分原因在于对生产力的担忧，而这种担忧在团队环境中可能被进一步放大。通过实验，我们分离出关于团队成员努力程度的地点性信念如何影响被分配与远程及办公室同事合作的参与者的自身努力选择。参与者执行一项实际努力任务，并可将该努力贡献至个人账户（按计件工资支付）或团队账户（采用最低努力支付方案）。我们发现，远程工作者完成的任务数量并不少于办公室同事。然而，团队因工人对远程同事贡献较少努力的信念而遭受努力水平下降。在后续处理中，我们证明即使在可能以搭便车信念为主导的收入共享团队支付方案下，这些基于地点的信念仍然显著。最后，我们提供独特证据表明，COVID-19大流行可能使人们对远程工作者努力的信念变得更加悲观，但并未改变实际努力水平。

title: The Global Transition – The Impact of Demographics and AI on Economic Power
title_zh: 全球转型——人口结构与人工智能对经济实力的影响
title_primary: 全球转型——人口结构与人工智能对经济实力的影响
title_secondary: The Global Transition – The Impact of Demographics and AI on Economic Power
authors: Seth G. Benzell, Laurence J. Kotlikoff, Victor Yifan Ye
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study deploys a multi-region, dynamic life-cycle, general equilibrium model to assess demography’s impact, through the course of this century, on global development. Our model’s 17 regions encompass more than 150 countries comprising 99% of the world’s population. Output is produced with three labor skill groups and internationally-mobile capital, with each country deciding annually whether to adopt its frontier automation technology. Our model features region-specific fiscal policy, TFP growth, and idiosyncratic mortality. Agents live for 100 years, first as children, then as workers, and then as retirees. Work and saving decisions are governed by CES preferences. Lifespan is uncertain, but there are no annuities apart from state pensions. Hence, bequests, while significant, are unintended. Our fertility, mortality, and net immigration rates are region- and age-specific and align fully with the UN’s projections. To illustrate demographics’ power to impact the global transition, we simulate our model under the UN’s markedly different demographic projections for 2017 and 2024. The 2024 forecast is particularly pessimistic about China’s fertility prospects. Both projections produce very substantial global aging, a major global capital glut producing very low long-run real capital returns. The latest forecast entails 10% lower global GDP in 2100 and far higher payroll tax rates to fund old-age benefits. Most important, it entails a major change in the course of economic hegemony with China’s 2100 global GDP share falling from 25.6% to 14.9% and the US share rising from 11.2% to 14.4%. Our results are sensitive. Should the US eliminate all future immigration, its 14.4% global 2100 GDP share would drop to 9.2%. And were global fertility to follow the UN’s low variant, 2100 world output would be one third, not one tenth lower. The level and division of global output is also highly sensitive to the speed at which AI expands frontier technologies. Accelerated AU/AI – 4x faster-than-recent growth in capital’s share through 2050 – or Transformative AU/AI – 10x faster capital-share growth – reinforce demographic forces, ensuring long-run US economic hegemony. Indeed, Transformative AI combined with 2024 demographics implies US and Chinese 2100 global GDP shares of 25.3% and 16.9%, respectively. And not withstanding its considerable technological catch up, the US retains, based on our calibration, a technological edge over China throughout the century.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用一个多区域、动态生命周期、一般均衡模型，评估本世纪人口因素对全球发展的影响。模型涵盖17个区域，包含150多个国家，占全球人口的99%。产出由三种劳动技能组和国际流动资本共同生产，每个国家每年决定是否采纳其前沿自动化技术。模型特点包括区域特定的财政政策、全要素生产率增长及特殊死亡率。个体寿命长达100年，先为儿童，后为劳动者，再为退休者。工作与储蓄决策受CES偏好支配。寿命存在不确定性，除国家养老金外无年金产品，因此遗赠虽显著，却属非预期。生育率、死亡率及净移民率均按区域和年龄划分，与联合国的预测完全一致。为展示人口对全球转型的影响力，我们依据联合国2017年和2024年显著不同的人口预测进行模拟。2024年的预测对中国生育前景尤为悲观。两种预测均导致全球严重老龄化，产生大量全球资本过剩，长期实际资本回报率极低。最新预测显示，2100年全球GDP将下降10%，为资助老年福利，工资税率将大幅提高。最重要的是，这预示着经济霸权格局的重大转变，中国2100年全球GDP份额将从25.6%降至14.9%，而美国份额将从11.2%升至14.4%。我们的结果具有敏感性。若美国完全停止未来移民，其2100年全球GDP份额将从14.4%降至9.2%。若全球生育率遵循联合国的低方案，2100年世界产出将减少三分之一，而非十分之一。全球产出的水平与分配对AI扩展前沿技术的速度也高度敏感。加速AI/自动化——至2050年资本份额增长速度为近年来的4倍——或变革性AI/自动化——资本份额增长速度快10倍——将强化人口力量，确保美国长期经济霸权。实际上，变革性AI结合2024年人口预测，意味着美国和中国2100年全球GDP份额分别为25.3%和16.9%。尽管美国在技术追赶方面有显著进展，但根据我们的校准，整个世纪美国对中国的技术优势依然存在。

title: 中国ESG研究中的数据分歧与误差校正
title_zh: 中国ESG研究中的数据分歧与误差校正
title_primary: 中国ESG研究中的数据分歧与误差校正
authors: 范子英, 谭伟杰, 孙俊秀, 郭峰
official: 官方发布 2026-08-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 近年来,ESG数据已成为学术研究的重要基础设施,但机构间的评级分歧降低了分析结论的可靠性与可比性。本文基于国内主流ESG评级机构的数据,通过对代表性研究主题的复现,发现研究结论往往依赖特定数据,来自不同数据供应商的ESG评级存在系统性差异,导致基于不同数据来源的研究结论明显不同。在详细拆解评级数据底层逻辑的基础上,本文用偏好依附理论解释ESG评级的动态形成机制,揭示了ESG数据中的“马太效应”,提出基于行业排名的非线性误差校正方法,并进一步验证了该方法在提升数据相关性、增强分析结论稳健性方面的效果。本文为提高中国ESG评级数据的一致性和ESG研究的稳健性提供了具体的操作指引。

title: Indian deindustrialization revisited: New data, estimates, and interpretations
title_zh: 印度去工业化再探讨：新数据、估算与解释
title_primary: 印度去工业化再探讨：新数据、估算与解释
title_secondary: Indian deindustrialization revisited: New data, estimates, and interpretations
authors: Alexander Nagar
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The fate of the handloom cotton textile industry is one of the most debated topics in the economic history of India. This paper presents novel employment estimates for cotton textile handweaving and spinning in the period 1800–1940. I put together plausible values for labour productivity and combine these with aggregate input usage to generate employment estimates. I then examine a number of related topics: the regional question, the relationship between handloom and power‐loom cloth from the consumer's perspective, the standard of living of handloom weavers, and the impact of technological progress within the handloom industry.
abstract_zh: 手织棉纺织业的命运是印度经济史中争论最为激烈的话题之一。本文提供了1800年至1940年间棉纺织手工织造与纺纱的新颖就业估算。我整合了合理的劳动生产率数值，并将其与总体投入使用情况相结合，以生成就业估算。随后，我探讨了若干相关议题：区域性问题、从消费者视角看手织机与动力织机布料之间的关系、手织机织工的生活水平，以及手织机行业内技术进步的影响。

title: The environmental justice implications of industry consolidation: Evidence from U.S. landfills
title_zh: 产业整合的环境正义影响：来自美国垃圾填埋场的证据
title_primary: 产业整合的环境正义影响：来自美国垃圾填埋场的证据
title_secondary: The environmental justice implications of industry consolidation: Evidence from U.S. landfills
authors: Hui Zhou, Shan Zhang, Matthew D. Gordon
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Over the past three decades, the number of U.S. landfills has fallen by 41%, while average capacity has risen by 130%. This paper studies the distributional consequences of this consolidation. We show these changes coincide with waste disposal shifting toward locations with lower population density and higher shares of low-income, Black, and Hispanic residents. Event studies of landfill openings rule out large effects on migration, though new landfills are sited in places with fast-changing demographics. Using a novel measure of regulation built from large-language-model classifications of state statutes, we show evidence that increased state regulations may contribute to increasing disparities.
abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，美国垃圾填埋场数量减少了41%，而平均容量却增加了130%。本文研究了这一整合过程带来的分配性后果。我们表明，这些变化与废物处理向人口密度较低、低收入、黑人和西班牙裔居民比例较高的地区转移的趋势相吻合。对垃圾填埋场开放的事件研究排除了其对迁移产生重大影响的可能性，尽管新填埋场选址于人口结构快速变化的地区。利用基于大型语言模型对州法规分类构建的新型监管度量，我们提供的证据表明，州级监管的加强可能加剧了这些不平等现象。

title: Using role models to inspire marginalized groups: A cautionary tale
title_zh: 利用榜样激励边缘群体：一则警示故事
title_primary: 利用榜样激励边缘群体：一则警示故事
title_secondary: Using role models to inspire marginalized groups: A cautionary tale
authors: Gaia Narciso, Carol Newman, Finn Tarp
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How can development programs reach geographically, politically, culturally, and economically isolated communities? We present experimental evidence on the impact of a role model intervention to inspire enterprise activity among ethnic minorities in Vietnam. We distinguish between relatable ethnic minority role models and ethnic majority role models to examine how increasing the social distance of a role model from the target population affects outcomes, while holding the information content constant. The intervention temporarily increased the locus of control of participants in the ethnic minority treatment, however, these effects were transient and faded over time. While behavioral responses were limited, we find some evidence that the social relatability of the role models was a slightly more important trigger for behavioral change than the information content. Ultimately, however, the limited effects of the treatments on enterprise activities did not translate into higher incomes for households at end-line. Overall, our findings provide a cautionary tale for the use of role models as a standalone intervention to generate sustained behavioral change.
abstract_zh: 发展项目如何触达地理、政治、文化及经济上孤立的社区？我们提供了关于榜样干预措施对越南少数民族创业活动影响的实验证据。我们区分了可亲近的少数民族榜样与多数民族榜样，以考察在保持信息内容不变的情况下，增加榜样与目标人群之间的社会距离如何影响结果。该干预措施暂时提升了少数民族受试者的控制点，但这些效应是短暂的，随时间逐渐消退。尽管行为反应有限，我们发现一些证据表明，榜样的社会亲近性在触发行为改变方面比信息内容略为重要。然而，最终，处理组对创业活动的有限影响并未在终期调查中转化为家庭收入的提高。总体而言，我们的发现为将榜样作为独立干预手段以产生持续行为改变提供了一个警示性案例。

title: Progressing towards efficiency: The role for labor tax progression in reforming social security
title_zh: 迈向效率：劳动税累进性在社会保障改革中的作用
title_primary: 迈向效率：劳动税累进性在社会保障改革中的作用
title_secondary: Progressing towards efficiency: The role for labor tax progression in reforming social security
authors: Krzysztof Makarski, Joanna Tyrowicz, Oliwia Komada
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the role for progressive labor income taxation in the context of social security reform. We propose a novel reform that replaces redistributive pensions with a contribution-based system while simultaneously increasing the progressivity of labor income taxation to preserve social insurance. Using a stylized model, we show that the benefit of such reform is derived from the Frisch elasticity of labor supply. For sufficiently high values, the reform can be fiscally neutral and Pareto-improving. We then evaluate the reform in a full general equilibrium model calibrated to the U.S. economy. Quantitative results on the efficiency-insurance trade-offs are in line with our theoretical predictions. In the steady-state, for plausible values of the Frisch elasticity, the fiscal space generated by increased labor supply is sufficient to compensate through lump-sum transfers the loss of pension-based insurance. These results carry over to transition dynamics: the reform yields a Pareto improvement along the transition path. Our findings highlight the potential for tax-based redistribution to replace pension-based insurance.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在社会保障改革背景下，累进劳动所得税的作用。我们提出了一项新颖的改革方案，即以缴费制养老金取代再分配型养老金，同时提高劳动所得税的累进性以维持社会保险。通过一个简化模型，我们证明此类改革的收益源于劳动供给的弗里斯弹性。当该弹性足够高时，改革可实现财政中性并达到帕累托改进。随后，我们在一个校准至美国经济的完整一般均衡模型中评估了这一改革。关于效率与保险权衡的量化结果与我们的理论预测一致。在稳态下，对于合理的弗里斯弹性值，由劳动供给增加所产生的财政空间足以通过一次性转移支付补偿因养老金保险减少而带来的损失。这些结论同样适用于转型动态：改革在转型路径上实现了帕累托改进。我们的发现凸显了基于税收的再分配替代基于养老金的保险的潜力。

title: DP37 The Next Birth and the Labour Market: A Dynamic Model of Births in England and Wales
title_zh: 下一次生育与劳动力市场：英格兰和威尔士生育动态模型
title_primary: 下一次生育与劳动力市场：英格兰和威尔士生育动态模型
title_secondary: DP37 The Next Birth and the Labour Market: A Dynamic Model of Births in England and Wales
authors: John F Ermisch, Eric De Cooman, Nezih Guner, Ezgi Kaya, Alessandro Ruggieri 等
official: 官方在线 1985-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper is to see how far developments in the labour market can help to explain the fluctuations in births which have been experienced over the period 1952-1980 in England and Wales. We examine separately the period rate of childless women proceeding to the first birth, mothers of one child proceeding to a second birth, mothers of two proceeding to a third birth, and mothers of three proceeding to a fourth birth. Our analysis shows that different birth orders respond differently to economic variables, and different age groups within a parity also exhibit varying responses. We have found that growing real wages for both men and women tend to deter older parents from adding to existing families. In the early stages of family building, births are inhibited by labour markets favourable to women. But conditions in the male labour market have the reverse effect on early breeding.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在探讨1952-1980年间英格兰和威尔士劳动力市场的发展在多大程度上能够解释生育率的波动。我们分别考察了无子女女性生育第一胎、一孩母亲生育第二胎、二孩母亲生育第三胎以及三孩母亲生育第四胎的时期生育率。分析表明，不同生育顺序对经济变量的反应存在差异，且同一胎次内的不同年龄组也表现出不同的反应。研究发现，男女实际工资的增长往往会抑制年长父母扩大家庭规模。在家庭组建初期，有利于女性的劳动力市场会抑制生育行为。然而，男性劳动力市场的状况对早期生育则产生相反的影响。

title: Cross‐Prudence and Optimal Prevention
title_zh: 跨谨慎与最优预防
title_primary: 跨谨慎与最优预防
title_secondary: Cross‐Prudence and Optimal Prevention
authors: Jingyuan Li, Richard Peter, Lin Zhou
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we study optimal prevention in the presence of a correlated nonfinancial background risk. Under positive correlation, cross‐prudence in the nonfinancial attribute reduces optimal prevention. We establish this result in the most direct extension of the standard prevention problem with binary marginal distributions and show that it extends to richer settings. Our analysis highlights a broader implication: in economically relevant cases with loss probabilities below one‐half and positive correlation, cross‐prudence emerges as an additional force that discourages prevention. As a result, optimal prevention can fall below the expected‐cost minimizing level, even when agents are risk‐averse.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了存在相关非金融背景风险时的最优预防行为。在正相关条件下，非金融属性的交叉审慎性会降低最优预防水平。我们通过标准预防问题最直接的二元边际分布扩展形式确立了这一结论，并证明该结论可推广至更丰富的设定。分析揭示了一个更广泛的意义：在损失概率低于二分之一且存在正相关的经济相关情形中，交叉审慎性成为抑制预防行为的额外因素。因此，即便代理人具有风险厌恶特征，最优预防水平仍可能低于预期成本最小化水平。

title: DP3429 Optimal Project Rejection and New Firm Start-Ups
title_zh: 最优项目拒绝与新创企业启动
title_primary: 最优项目拒绝与新创企业启动
title_secondary: DP3429 Optimal Project Rejection and New Firm Start-Ups
authors: Bruno Cassiman, Masako Ueda
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Entrants are typically found to be more innovative than incumbent firms. Furthermore, these innovative ideas often originate with established firms in the industry. Therefore, the established firm and the start-up firm seem to select different types of projects. We claim that this is the consequence of their optimal project allocation mechanism, which depends on their comparative advantage. The start-up firm may seem more ?innovative? than the established firm may because the comparative advantage of the start-up firm is to commercialize ?innovative? projects, i.e. projects that do not fit with the established firms? existing assets. Our model integrates various facts found in the industrial organization literature about the entry rate, firm focus, firm growth, industry growth and innovation. We also obtain some counter-intuitive results such that a reduction in the cost of start-ups may actually slow down start-ups and that the firm may voluntarily give away the property rights to the inventions discovered within the firm.
abstract_zh: 通常发现，新进入企业比在位企业更具创新性。此外，这些创新想法往往源自行业内的成熟企业。因此，成熟企业与初创企业似乎选择了不同类型的项目。我们认为，这是其最优项目分配机制的结果，该机制取决于各自的比较优势。初创企业可能比成熟企业显得更具"创新性"，原因在于初创企业的比较优势在于将"创新性"项目商业化，即那些与成熟企业现有资产不匹配的项目。我们的模型整合了产业组织文献中关于进入率、企业专注度、企业成长、行业增长及创新的多种事实。我们还得出了一些反直觉的结论，例如降低初创企业的成本实际上可能减缓其发展速度，以及企业可能自愿放弃内部发明的产权。

title: Measuring the Sources of Taste-Based Discrimination Using List Experiments
title_zh: 使用列举实验测量基于偏好的歧视来源
title_primary: 使用列举实验测量基于偏好的歧视来源
title_secondary: Measuring the Sources of Taste-Based Discrimination Using List Experiments
authors: Ariel Listo, Ercio A. Muñoz, Dario Sansone
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how attitudes among supervisors, co-workers, and customers are related to discrimination against sexual minority individuals in the workplace. Participants from a large, nationally representative online sample in Chile took part in double list experiments  which reduce social desirability bias when eliciting views on sensitive topics  followed by direct questions on attitudes toward sexual minority individuals. The findings reveal a discrepancy between reported and actual levels of comfort with gay individuals in the labor market. The respondents underreported their discomfort by 15-23 percentage points, with the largest bias and lowest comfort levels observed when they were asked about supervising gay employees. These attitudinal patterns were mirrored in incentivized donation behavior: individuals who chose not to donate any amount from a lottery to a local LGBTQ-related nonprofit reported lower comfort levels and exhibited greater misreporting. Finally, the respondents consistently underestimated the broader societal support for gay employees and co-workers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了主管、同事及顾客的态度如何与工作场所中对性少数个体的歧视相关联。来自智利一个大型、具有全国代表性的在线样本的参与者参与了双重列表实验——该实验在探讨敏感话题时能减少社会期望偏差——随后直接回答了关于对性少数个体态度的问题。研究结果揭示了在劳动力市场中对同性恋个体所报告的实际舒适度与真实舒适度之间存在差异。受访者将其不适感低估了15至23个百分点，其中在询问关于监督同性恋员工时，偏差最大且舒适度最低。这些态度模式在激励性捐赠行为中得到了体现：选择不从彩票中捐赠任何金额给当地LGBTQ相关非营利组织的个体，报告了较低的舒适度，并表现出更大的误报倾向。最后，受访者普遍低估了社会对同性恋员工及同事的更广泛支持。

title: Anecdotes or Statistics?
title_zh: 轶事还是统计数据？
title_primary: 轶事还是统计数据？
title_secondary: Anecdotes or Statistics?
authors: Arjada Bardhi, Nina Bobkova
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why might persuaders favor anecdotes over aggregate statistics? We study a policy advocate choosing between them to persuade a diverse, skeptical citizenry with demographically correlated outcomes. Two forces compete: an umbrella effect, by which everyone responds more strongly to the statistic, and a wild-card effect, by which the anecdote's higher variance makes favorable realizations likelier. The anecdote prevails under sufficiently narrow consensus, so its appeal has a rational, informational basis. When breadth of aggregation is flexible, the optimal evidence is a local statistic that aggregates over a broader subpopulation than the minimal winning coalition, though almost anecdotal as consensus narrows.
abstract_zh: 为何说服者更偏爱轶事而非总体统计数据？我们研究了一位政策倡导者在两者间的选择，其目标是说服一个具有人口统计相关结果的多元化、持怀疑态度的公民群体。两种效应相互竞争：一是“伞效应”，即每个人对统计数据的反应更为强烈；二是“野牌效应”，即轶事的高方差使得有利结果更可能出现。当共识足够狭窄时，轶事占据上风，因此其吸引力具有理性的信息基础。当聚合范围灵活时，最优证据是一种局部统计量，它聚合了比最小获胜联盟更广泛的子群体，但随着共识变窄，这种统计量几乎接近于轶事。

title: How important is global r-star for open economies?
title_zh: 全球r-star对开放经济体的重要性如何？
title_primary: 全球r-star对开放经济体的重要性如何？
title_secondary: How important is global r-star for open economies?
authors: James Morley, Benjamin Wong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the relevance of global shocks in determining r-star for a set of typically studied advanced open economies (Australia, Canada, Euro Area, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden, and the United Kingdom). To do so, we apply a multivariate Beveridge–Nelson decomposition using a two-block small open economy Bayesian vector autoregression for each economy with the United States in the foreign block and imposing long-run restrictions to identify the role of global shocks in driving domestic r-star. We document three key findings: (i) U.S. r-star provides a sufficient proxy for global r-star from the perspective of these seven open economies; (ii) local shocks with no impact on U.S. r-star are important for domestic r-stars, leaving open the potential that domestic macroeconomic policies can complement or offset the global forces determining r-star; and (iii) even though local shocks are important, global forces played the dominant role in the long-term decline in r-stars for all seven open economies following the global financial crisis.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球冲击在决定一组典型发达开放经济体（澳大利亚、加拿大、欧元区、新西兰、挪威、瑞典和英国）的r-star中的相关性。为此，我们采用多元贝弗里奇-尼尔森分解方法，对每个经济体应用一个以美国为外国区块的两区块小型开放经济贝叶斯向量自回归模型，并施加长期限制以识别全球冲击在驱动国内r-star中的作用。我们记录了三个关键发现：（i）从这七个开放经济体的角度来看，美国的r-star为全球r-star提供了充分的代理指标；（ii）对美国r-star无影响的本地冲击对国内r-star具有重要意义，这为国内宏观经济政策补充或抵消决定r-star的全球力量留下了可能性；（iii）尽管本地冲击重要，但在全球金融危机后，全球力量在七个开放经济体r-star的长期下降中发挥了主导作用。

authors: Marcus Hagedorn
official: 官方在线 2026-05-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Heterogeneous agent incomplete markets models offer a new perspective on price and inflation determination. In contrast to complete markets, the price level is determined from the asset‐market clearing condition. Fiscal and monetary policy then jointly and uniquely determine the finite steady‐state price level and the inflation rate, including in a steady state in which the nominal interest rate is constant. Fiscal policy can determine the long‐run inflation rate for a fiscal rule which sets the growth rate of nominal government debt, whereas both fiscal and monetary policy determine the long‐run inflation rate under different tax rules.
abstract_zh: 异质性主体不完全市场模型为价格与通胀决定提供了新视角。与完全市场不同，价格水平由资产市场出清条件决定。财政与货币政策共同且唯一地决定了有限稳态价格水平与通胀率，包括名义利率保持不变的稳态情形。在设定名义政府债务增长率的财政规则下，财政政策可决定长期通胀率；而在不同税收规则下，财政与货币政策共同决定长期通胀率。

title: Coasian bargaining, political incentives, and pollution spillovers: evidence from China
title_zh: 科斯谈判、政治激励与污染溢出：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 科斯谈判、政治激励与污染溢出：来自中国的证据

authors: Mengxia Zhou, Yongbin Xu
official: 官方在线 2025-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study provides novel evidence on how Coasian bargaining can mitigate pollution spillovers. In this setting, water quality targets are negotiated to give upstream officials in regulated regions close to political borders more incentives to enforce tighter environmental regulations. Exploiting the first introduction of the ecological compensation initiative in the Xin’an River in 2011, we find that regulated firms have more than 56.95% lower chemical oxygen demand (COD) emission intensity but no lower output than unregulated firms in the same province. The salient gap in regulatory enforcement is driven by high-powered political incentives, in which water quality targets are internalized into government officials’ political promotion evaluations. However, differential regulatory enforcement tends to concentrate on water pollution from regulated to unregulated regions within the same jurisdiction, thereby exposing rivers, residents, and public health to higher levels of pollution.
abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于科斯式谈判如何缓解污染溢出效应的新证据。在该情境下，水质目标通过协商制定，旨在激励靠近政治边界的受监管地区的地方官员强化环境规制执行力度。基于2011年新安江流域首次实施生态补偿机制的准自然实验，研究发现：受监管企业的化学需氧量（COD）排放强度较同省未受监管企业下降超过56.95%，但产出水平并未降低。这种规制执行强度的显著差异源于高能政治激励——水质目标被纳入政府官员的政治晋升考核体系。然而，差异化的规制执行导致同一行政辖区内受监管地区的水污染向未受监管地区转移，进而使河流、居民及公共健康暴露于更高污染水平。
